The supplied third-party Blender source was available locally for technical
prototype preparation, but no bundled license, author record, source URL, or
redistribution permission was found in the repository or alongside the
provided source during this review.

The original source is preserved separately from the neutral production asset.
The production GLB, metadata, previews, and generated documentation use only
the neutral `Antey` identity and do not carry source-specific historical
markings. This technical preparation does not establish a right to ship the
source-derived geometry or any derivative work.

The authoring review used these public references, kept outside the runtime
export:

- [DeepStorm Project 949A page](https://deepstorm.ru/DeepStorm.files/45-92/nsrs/949A/list.htm): side/top project drawing and dimensional/arrangement reference; no redistribution license was identified on the page.
- [Wikimedia Commons Oscar II class SSGN.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Oscar_II_class_SSGN.svg): author listed as Mike1979 Russia; page lists CC BY-SA 3.0 and GFDL. This attribution applies to that reference drawing only, not to the supplied source model.
- [Bellona The Arctic Nuclear Challenge PDF](https://network.bellona.org/content/uploads/sites/3/The_Arctic_Nuclear_Challenge.pdf): dimensional cross-check; no source-model license is inferred.

The current authoring choice is four 533 mm and two 650 mm bow markers, based
on the supplied reference sheets and the NTI summary. It remains a revisable
content-authoring contract until future combat implementation; no internal
weapon mechanism is inferred.

Before commercial or public distribution, record the verified author,
canonical source URL, license text, attribution requirements, and any
share-alike or derivative-work obligations in the project's approved
third-party attribution mechanism. Do not remove required attribution from
the immutable source record.
